scientific_checks: Two substantive author/reviewer passes: official merged CSIR Unit 3.A page 4, separate CSIR Unit 3.A page 2 and archived MP SET 2024 page 2 visually checked. Reviewed replicator/initiator, cis/trans, oriV/oriT, bidirectional and unidirectional theta, ColE1 RNA I/II and Pol I, iterons and yeast 2-micron plasmid, dso/sso and nick polarity, copy control and random segregation assumptions, shared replication/partition incompatibility, free vs integrated F, Pol gamma/TWINKLE/OriH/OriL/7S DNA, plant genome forms, lambda/phiX174/adenovirus/SV40 and gel interpretation. 30 programmatic numerical checks passed; examples include two-fork traversal, copy-number feedback, random segregation, mixed populations, mtDNA timing, plasmid DNA fractions and all 19 Part C quantitative problems. Reviewed figure labels and geometry, corrected copy-number graph scale and label. All practice original and numerical/experimental teaching datasets identified as hypothetical.
limitations: Internal author/reviewer self-assessment only; no external peer review. Source records and accessible excerpts/reviews verified, not every cited full paper. Static markup, labels, links and arithmetic tested; no browser/device rendering or interactive accessibility audit.
